scoring_justification: Checker recomputes reference temperature values from the given model and parameters using fine-time discretization and compares each reported value within a tolerance, as the result is a deterministic numerical integration.

outputs.description: Transient junction temperature increase ΔT_c above the heat sink at five time points for four pulse widths t_m (30, 50, 70, 90 ns).

output_contract.notes: The temperature rise is produced by a deterministic numerical integration; scoring is by exact match within a hidden tolerance.
